evals.prompt: Plan two launch pages. Page A has approved licensed product photography, logo files, and complete UI screenshots. Page B only has a Pinterest board and one cinematic reference frame for its hero. Keep the planning efficient and call out what each page needs before frontend work.
evals.expected_output: Records provenance and skips discovery for complete licensed assets; Routes missing reference-led media through Asset Advisor; Requires source-role, rights, moodboard, output, and acceptance evidence; Does not treat inspiration as licensed production media; Blocks only actual unresolved gaps
assertions: Records provenance and an explicit Asset Advisor skip reason for Page A because its supplied licensed media set is complete.
Routes Page B through Asset Advisor before approving the landing specification.
Requires Page B to resolve source roles, rights status, accepted moodboard traits, sourcing or generation, concrete outputs, and acceptance checks.
Does not treat the Pinterest board or cinematic frame as licensed production media.
Keeps frontend handoff blocked only for each page's actual unresolved specification or asset gaps.

farplane.title: Routes landing assets conditionally instead of always or never
anti_patterns: Runs external discovery again for a complete licensed asset set
Lets reference-only media pass directly to frontend implementation
Treats Pinterest as production licensing evidence
Blocks the complete page for work only the incomplete page needs
